# Setup GitHub Actions CI

This skill configures GitHub Actions so every php-ai-toolkit gate is visible in
CI and the workflow follows Actions security and maintainability practices.

## Discover Project Constraints

Read these files before editing CI:

- `composer.json`: `require.php`, `config.platform.php`, and Composer scripts.
- Existing `.github/workflows/*.yml` or `.yaml`.
- Toolkit configs that imply CI gates: `.php-cs-fixer.dist.php`,
  `phpstan.neon`, `phpcs.xml.dist`, `loc.yaml`, `tree.yaml`, `deptrac.yaml`,
  `phpunit.xml.dist`.
- Project docs that declare supported PHP versions.
- Composer lock policy: one normal `composer.lock`, no committed lock, or
  PHP-versioned locks such as `composer.lock.php-<minor>`.
- Composer platform requirements and each command's runtime needs. Derive the
  `setup-php` extension list from `composer check-platform-reqs` plus the
  config-driven needs below; do not rely on what `ubuntu-latest` happens to
  preinstall, and do not copy another project's list.

Extensions that a project's configuration demands even though no `require`
declares them:

| Extension | Needed by | Failure without it |
|-----------|-----------|--------------------|
| `mbstring` | `phpunit/phpunit` and `infection/infection` require it directly | `composer install` fails the platform check |
| `pcntl` | `phpunit/php-invoker`, which implements PHPUnit's `enforceTimeLimit="true"` | Time limits are not enforced; PHPUnit 10+ raises a runner warning that `failOnAllIssues="true"` turns into exit 1 |
| `pcov` or Xdebug | Coverage and mutation testing | No coverage data |
| GD with FreeType | DocGen social preview images | Image generation fails |

ParaTest does not need `pcntl`: it starts workers through `symfony/process`, and
its own `ext-pcntl` entry is a `require-dev` for its own test suite.

Apply the list to every job that installs the dev graph or runs tests, including a
mutation-testing job — it executes the same `phpunit.xml.dist` through Infection
and hits the same requirements as the test job.

If the declared PHP floor, Composer constraint, docs, and CI matrix disagree,
surface the conflict and make CI match the declared support policy.

## Template

Read the template from
`vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-github-actions/ci.yml`
and apply it to the project root as `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

The template contains `REPLACE_WITH_*` sentinels instead of this repository's PHP
matrix and lock policy. Replace every sentinel from target-project evidence before
installing the workflow; a remaining sentinel is a failed setup, not a default.

If a workflow already exists, merge rather than blindly replacing it.

## Required CI Gates

The workflow must make the toolkit checks observable as separate named steps.
Do not hide all lint gates behind a single unnamed `composer lint` step.

Required gates when the corresponding script/config exists:

- `composer format:check` for PHP-CS-Fixer.
- `composer phpstan` for PHPStan and toolkit PHPStan rules.
- `composer compat` for PHPCompatibility.
- `composer loc-guard` for LocGuard.
- `composer tree-guard` for TreeGuard.
- `composer deptrac` for Deptrac.
- `composer test` for the PHPUnit suite when ParaTest is installed, otherwise
  `composer test:unit`.

Property-based tests configured by `/setup-toolkit-pbt` run through
`composer test:pbt` in their separate `pbt.yml` workflow. Verify that workflow is
present and that ordinary PHPUnit and ParaTest commands exclude the `pbt` group;
do not add the slower group to the normal test matrix as well.

Every gate the project has configured belongs in CI. A tool that is installed,
configured, and wired into `composer lint` but never runs on the default branch
is a gate the project believes it has: it passes locally for whoever last ran it
and drifts from then on. When a config file exists and its Composer script does
not run anywhere in CI, that is the finding to report, not a detail to leave.

Keep `compat` inside the `lint` job alongside formatting, PHPStan, LocGuard,
TreeGuard, and Deptrac. It may be a separate step for visibility, but it should
not be a separate CI job unless the project has an explicit reason. Namespace
visibility is enforced by the toolkit's PHPStan rules and needs no separate CI
step.

If a script is missing but the config exists, add the Composer script using the
corresponding setup skill before wiring CI. If neither script nor config exists,
do not invent the gate in CI; set up that tool first.

### The Parallel Test Runner

When ParaTest is installed, make `composer test` select it and run that command in
the normal PHP matrix. Do not add a second sequential PHPUnit job: ParaTest already
executes the PHPUnit suite, and the matrix simultaneously verifies runtime support
and isolation across worker processes.

A real multi-major matrix must use the version-selecting `tests/run.php` runner from
`/setup-toolkit-phpunit`, so ParaTest receives the configuration matching the
installed PHPUnit major. Do not rely on the newest `phpunit.xml.dist` under older
dependency graphs. Keep `composer test:unit` available for local debugging and for
tools that specifically require PHPUnit, but CI does not need to repeat it.

## Separate Decision: Documentation Publishing

Do not add documentation generation or GitHub Pages publishing to `ci.yml`.
Those live in their own workflows, and their templates and the questions to ask
before installing them belong to the `/setup-toolkit-docgen` skill.

Do not silently finish when the project has a `docgen` script but no DocGen
workflow. Ask the user to choose one of the three supported outcomes: local only,
publish the default branch, or publish the default branch plus pull-request diff
previews. Then use `/setup-toolkit-docgen` for the chosen workflows. The workflows
remain separate from `ci.yml` so publishing permissions do not leak into CI.

## Out of Scope: Mutation Testing

Do not write a mutation testing job from scratch. `/setup-toolkit-infection` ships
the job together with the configuration it depends on, because the job needs a
coverage driver, `fetch-depth: 0`, and a different Composer script per event. Point
the user there when they ask for an Infection job.

## Out of Scope: Performance Benchmarks

Do not add PHPBench to the normal test or lint matrix. `/setup-toolkit-phpbench`
owns the benchmark contract, stable runner settings, paired merge-target and
candidate measurements, relative gate, job summary, and evidence Artifact. A
benchmark command run once on one matrix leg is neither a comparison nor a useful
performance gate.

## Out of Scope: Fuzzing

Do not write a generic fuzz job in `ci.yml`. `/setup-toolkit-fuzzing` derives the
input generator and oracle from a specific contract and ships a separate scheduled
workflow with corpus caching and crash artifacts. A random-input loop without that
contract design is not a CI gate.

## PHP Version Coverage

CI must match the project's declared support range. Do not compensate for a
bad Composer constraint by narrowing the workflow matrix.

1. Determine the supported PHP range from `composer.json require.php` and the
   project docs.
2. List every supported minor version in the `tests` matrix.
3. Prefer the project's existing lock policy. A normal single `composer.lock`
   is fine for most applications. Use PHP-versioned lock files only when a
   supported older PHP minor needs a different dependency graph and the project
   has a supply-chain requirement to pin those graphs, which is common for
   libraries and developer tools.
4. If the project uses PHP-versioned lock files, make sure every matrix minor
   has a matching `composer.lock.php-<minor>` file.
5. Check whether dev dependencies can install on each minor:
   ```bash
   cp "composer.lock.php-<minor>" composer.lock
   composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
   ```
6. If dependencies do not install on a supported PHP minor, fix the Composer
   constraints first. Select the newest compatible tool line for that leg and add
   an older line only when Composer proves the target matrix needs it.
7. Run the lint gates as named steps in one `lint` job on the highest supported
   runtime compatible with the tooling. PHPCompatibility checks the declared PHP
   range; repeating formatting, PHPStan, LocGuard, TreeGuard, and Deptrac on every
   runtime adds no distinct gate.
8. Use the highest matrix minor for one-off mutation, documentation, and benchmark
   jobs unless the tool cannot run there. Record that limitation rather than
   copying the template's PHP literal.

Never use `--ignore-platform-reqs` to make a lower PHP job pass. That hides a
real compatibility problem.

The workflow template is deliberately incomplete until its PHP values, test command,
extensions, branches, and lock steps are derived from the target. Never retain a
literal merely because it matches php-ai-toolkit's own CI. In particular, do not
copy this repository's full matrix or versioned-lock topology into a single-runtime
application.

When generating PHP-versioned lock files, do not write `config.platform.php`
into the root `composer.json`. Repeat this process for each minor in the target's
actual support matrix, using a temporary directory and Composer home:

```bash
target_php='<supported-minor>'
lock_tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
composer_home_dir="$lock_tmp_dir/composer-home"
mkdir -p "$composer_home_dir"
cp composer.json "$lock_tmp_dir/composer.json"
COMPOSER_HOME="$composer_home_dir" composer --working-dir="$lock_tmp_dir" config -g platform.php "$target_php.0"
COMPOSER_HOME="$composer_home_dir" composer --working-dir="$lock_tmp_dir" update --no-install --no-audit --no-interaction --no-progress
cp "$lock_tmp_dir/composer.lock" "composer.lock.php-$target_php"
```

## Actions Best Practices

Apply these rules to every workflow created by this skill:

- Pin every external action with the full 40-character commit SHA.
- Keep workflow YAML free of explanatory comments, including release-tag comments
  after action SHAs. Use clear job and step names.
- Verify each SHA from the action's original repository:
  ```bash
  gh release view --repo actions/checkout --json tagName,publishedAt,url
  git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/checkout.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'
  ```
- Use top-level `permissions: contents: read` and only grant additional
  permissions for a step that truly needs them.
- Use `pull_request`, not `pull_request_target`, for untrusted PR code.
- Use `concurrency` with PR number or ref and `cancel-in-progress: true`.
- Set `fail-fast: false` for version matrices so all supported minors report.
- Add `timeout-minutes` to jobs.
- Give every job and every step a clear `name`.
- Do not use `continue-on-error` for required lint or test gates.
- When versioned lock files are used, copy the matching lock to `composer.lock`
  before validation and installation, then install with locked dependencies and
  `require-lock-file: true`. Run `composer check-platform-reqs` after installation.
- When no lock file is committed, do not claim `dependency-versions: locked` and
  do not set `require-lock-file: true`; deliberately install the dependency mode
  the project chose.
- Let `ramsey/composer-install` handle Composer caching; do not add a second
  Composer cache step unless the project has a measured reason.

Job timeouts, PHP memory limits, and worker counts are operational starting
points. Measure sustained runtime, peak memory, and runner capacity, then adjust
them with headroom. Never use those settings to narrow a gate, skip targets, or
turn a quality failure into a pass. The template's values are not target-project
facts.

## Updating Action Pins

When refreshing the template, resolve current releases and SHAs before editing:

```bash
gh release view --repo actions/checkout --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/checkout.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'

gh release view --repo shivammathur/setup-php --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/shivammathur/setup-php.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'

gh release view --repo ramsey/composer-install --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/ramsey/composer-install.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'
```

Use the SHA returned for the exact tag. Do not use a moving branch, a major tag,
or an abbreviated SHA. Do not append the tag as a YAML comment.

## Verification

After editing the workflow:

```bash
git diff --check
go run github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@latest .github/workflows/ci.yml
```

Run local Composer checks that are reasonably available:

```bash
composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
# Repeat validation with each target-project lock when versioned locks exist.
composer format:check
composer phpstan
composer compat
composer loc-guard
composer tree-guard
composer deptrac
composer test:unit
composer test
```

Then check that nothing configured was left out of the workflow. Every Composer
script the project treats as a gate should appear in `ci.yml`:

```bash
composer run-script --list
grep -o 'composer [a-z:-]*' .github/workflows/ci.yml | sort -u
```

If a local check cannot run because of the local PHP version or missing tools,
state that clearly and rely on the CI job that covers it.

## References

- [GitHub Actions security hardening](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-guides/security-hardening-for-github-actions)
- [GitHub Actions workflow syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions)
- [Composer Install action](https://github.com/ramsey/composer-install)

- Existing `.github/workflows/*.yml` or `.yaml`.
- Toolkit configs that imply CI gates: `.php-cs-fixer.dist.php`,
  `phpstan.neon`, `phpcs.xml.dist`, `loc.yaml`, `tree.yaml`, `deptrac.yaml`,
  `phpunit.xml.dist`.

- Composer lock policy: one normal `composer.lock`, no committed lock, or
  PHP-versioned locks such as `composer.lock.php-<minor>`.

  `setup-php` extension list from `composer check-platform-reqs` plus the
  config-driven needs below; do not rely on what `ubuntu-latest` happens to
  preinstall, and do not copy another project's list.

declares them:

| Extension | Needed by | Failure without it |
|-----------|-----------|--------------------|

| `pcntl` | `phpunit/php-invoker`, which implements PHPUnit's `enforceTimeLimit="true"` | Time limits are not enforced; PHPUnit 10+ raises a runner warning that `failOnAllIssues="true"` turns into exit 1 |
| `pcov` or Xdebug | Coverage and mutation testing | No coverage data |
| GD with FreeType | DocGen social preview images | Image generation fails |

ParaTest does not need `pcntl`: it starts workers through `symfony/process`, and
its own `ext-pcntl` entry is a `require-dev` for its own test suite.

Apply the list to every job that installs the dev graph or runs tests, including a
mutation-testing job — it executes the same `phpunit.xml.dist` through Infection
and hits the same requirements as the test job.

If the declared PHP floor, Composer constraint, docs, and CI matrix disagree,
surface the conflict and make CI match the declared support policy.

Read the template from
`vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-github-actions/ci.yml`
and apply it to the project root as `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

matrix and lock policy. Replace every sentinel from target-project evidence before
installing the workflow; a remaining sentinel is a failed setup, not a default.

The workflow must make the toolkit checks observable as separate named steps.
Do not hide all lint gates behind a single unnamed `composer lint` step.

- `composer format:check` for PHP-CS-Fixer.
- `composer phpstan` for PHPStan and toolkit PHPStan rules.
- `composer compat` for PHPCompatibility.

- `composer tree-guard` for TreeGuard.
- `composer deptrac` for Deptrac.

name: CI (sql-faker)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/sql-faker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/sql-faker.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/sql-faker-fuzz.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/sql-faker

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
      - run: composer test

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'

# Setup GitHub Actions CI

This skill configures GitHub Actions so every php-ai-toolkit gate is visible in
CI and the workflow follows Actions security and maintainability practices.

## Discover Project Constraints

Read these files before editing CI:

- `composer.json`: `require.php`, `config.platform.php`, and Composer scripts.
- Existing `.github/workflows/*.yml` or `.yaml`.
- Toolkit configs that imply CI gates: `.php-cs-fixer.dist.php`,
  `phpstan.neon`, `phpcs.xml.dist`, `loc.yaml`, `tree.yaml`, `deptrac.yaml`,
  `phpunit.xml.dist`.
- Project docs that declare supported PHP versions.
- Composer lock policy: one normal `composer.lock`, no committed lock, or
  PHP-versioned locks such as `composer.lock.php-<minor>`.
- Composer platform requirements and each command's runtime needs. Derive the
  `setup-php` extension list from `composer check-platform-reqs` plus the
  config-driven needs below; do not rely on what `ubuntu-latest` happens to
  preinstall, and do not copy another project's list.

Extensions that a project's configuration demands even though no `require`
declares them:

| Extension | Needed by | Failure without it |
|-----------|-----------|--------------------|
| `mbstring` | `phpunit/phpunit` and `infection/infection` require it directly | `composer install` fails the platform check |
| `pcntl` | `phpunit/php-invoker`, which implements PHPUnit's `enforceTimeLimit="true"` | Time limits are not enforced; PHPUnit 10+ raises a runner warning that `failOnAllIssues="true"` turns into exit 1 |
| `pcov` or Xdebug | Coverage and mutation testing | No coverage data |
| GD with FreeType | DocGen social preview images | Image generation fails |

ParaTest does not need `pcntl`: it starts workers through `symfony/process`, and
its own `ext-pcntl` entry is a `require-dev` for its own test suite.

Apply the list to every job that installs the dev graph or runs tests, including a
mutation-testing job — it executes the same `phpunit.xml.dist` through Infection
and hits the same requirements as the test job.

If the declared PHP floor, Composer constraint, docs, and CI matrix disagree,
surface the conflict and make CI match the declared support policy.

## Template

Read the template from
`vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-github-actions/ci.yml`
and apply it to the project root as `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

The template contains `REPLACE_WITH_*` sentinels instead of this repository's PHP
matrix and lock policy. Replace every sentinel from target-project evidence before
installing the workflow; a remaining sentinel is a failed setup, not a default.

If a workflow already exists, merge rather than blindly replacing it.

## Required CI Gates

The workflow must make the toolkit checks observable as separate named steps.
Do not hide all lint gates behind a single unnamed `composer lint` step.

Required gates when the corresponding script/config exists:

- `composer format:check` for PHP-CS-Fixer.
- `composer phpstan` for PHPStan and toolkit PHPStan rules.
- `composer compat` for PHPCompatibility.
- `composer loc-guard` for LocGuard.
- `composer tree-guard` for TreeGuard.
- `composer deptrac` for Deptrac.
- `composer test` for the PHPUnit suite when ParaTest is installed, otherwise
  `composer test:unit`.

Property-based tests configured by `/setup-toolkit-pbt` run through
`composer test:pbt` in their separate `pbt.yml` workflow. Verify that workflow is
present and that ordinary PHPUnit and ParaTest commands exclude the `pbt` group;
do not add the slower group to the normal test matrix as well.

Every gate the project has configured belongs in CI. A tool that is installed,
configured, and wired into `composer lint` but never runs on the default branch
is a gate the project believes it has: it passes locally for whoever last ran it
and drifts from then on. When a config file exists and its Composer script does
not run anywhere in CI, that is the finding to report, not a detail to leave.

Keep `compat` inside the `lint` job alongside formatting, PHPStan, LocGuard,
TreeGuard, and Deptrac. It may be a separate step for visibility, but it should
not be a separate CI job unless the project has an explicit reason. Namespace
visibility is enforced by the toolkit's PHPStan rules and needs no separate CI
step.

If a script is missing but the config exists, add the Composer script using the
corresponding setup skill before wiring CI. If neither script nor config exists,
do not invent the gate in CI; set up that tool first.

### The Parallel Test Runner

When ParaTest is installed, make `composer test` select it and run that command in
the normal PHP matrix. Do not add a second sequential PHPUnit job: ParaTest already
executes the PHPUnit suite, and the matrix simultaneously verifies runtime support
and isolation across worker processes.

A real multi-major matrix must use the version-selecting `tests/run.php` runner from
`/setup-toolkit-phpunit`, so ParaTest receives the configuration matching the
installed PHPUnit major. Do not rely on the newest `phpunit.xml.dist` under older
dependency graphs. Keep `composer test:unit` available for local debugging and for
tools that specifically require PHPUnit, but CI does not need to repeat it.

## Separate Decision: Documentation Publishing

Do not add documentation generation or GitHub Pages publishing to `ci.yml`.
Those live in their own workflows, and their templates and the questions to ask
before installing them belong to the `/setup-toolkit-docgen` skill.

Do not silently finish when the project has a `docgen` script but no DocGen
workflow. Ask the user to choose one of the three supported outcomes: local only,
publish the default branch, or publish the default branch plus pull-request diff
previews. Then use `/setup-toolkit-docgen` for the chosen workflows. The workflows
remain separate from `ci.yml` so publishing permissions do not leak into CI.

## Out of Scope: Mutation Testing

Do not write a mutation testing job from scratch. `/setup-toolkit-infection` ships
the job together with the configuration it depends on, because the job needs a
coverage driver, `fetch-depth: 0`, and a different Composer script per event. Point
the user there when they ask for an Infection job.

## Out of Scope: Performance Benchmarks

Do not add PHPBench to the normal test or lint matrix. `/setup-toolkit-phpbench`
owns the benchmark contract, stable runner settings, paired merge-target and
candidate measurements, relative gate, job summary, and evidence Artifact. A
benchmark command run once on one matrix leg is neither a comparison nor a useful
performance gate.

## Out of Scope: Fuzzing

Do not write a generic fuzz job in `ci.yml`. `/setup-toolkit-fuzzing` derives the
input generator and oracle from a specific contract and ships a separate scheduled
workflow with corpus caching and crash artifacts. A random-input loop without that
contract design is not a CI gate.

## PHP Version Coverage

CI must match the project's declared support range. Do not compensate for a
bad Composer constraint by narrowing the workflow matrix.

1. Determine the supported PHP range from `composer.json require.php` and the
   project docs.
2. List every supported minor version in the `tests` matrix.
3. Prefer the project's existing lock policy. A normal single `composer.lock`
   is fine for most applications. Use PHP-versioned lock files only when a
   supported older PHP minor needs a different dependency graph and the project
   has a supply-chain requirement to pin those graphs, which is common for
   libraries and developer tools.
4. If the project uses PHP-versioned lock files, make sure every matrix minor
   has a matching `composer.lock.php-<minor>` file.
5. Check whether dev dependencies can install on each minor:
   ```bash
   cp "composer.lock.php-<minor>" composer.lock
   composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
   ```
6. If dependencies do not install on a supported PHP minor, fix the Composer
   constraints first. Select the newest compatible tool line for that leg and add
   an older line only when Composer proves the target matrix needs it.
7. Run the lint gates as named steps in one `lint` job on the highest supported
   runtime compatible with the tooling. PHPCompatibility checks the declared PHP
   range; repeating formatting, PHPStan, LocGuard, TreeGuard, and Deptrac on every
   runtime adds no distinct gate.
8. Use the highest matrix minor for one-off mutation, documentation, and benchmark
   jobs unless the tool cannot run there. Record that limitation rather than
   copying the template's PHP literal.

Never use `--ignore-platform-reqs` to make a lower PHP job pass. That hides a
real compatibility problem.

The workflow template is deliberately incomplete until its PHP values, test command,
extensions, branches, and lock steps are derived from the target. Never retain a
literal merely because it matches php-ai-toolkit's own CI. In particular, do not
copy this repository's full matrix or versioned-lock topology into a single-runtime
application.

When generating PHP-versioned lock files, do not write `config.platform.php`
into the root `composer.json`. Repeat this process for each minor in the target's
actual support matrix, using a temporary directory and Composer home:

```bash
target_php='<supported-minor>'
lock_tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
composer_home_dir="$lock_tmp_dir/composer-home"
mkdir -p "$composer_home_dir"
cp composer.json "$lock_tmp_dir/composer.json"
COMPOSER_HOME="$composer_home_dir" composer --working-dir="$lock_tmp_dir" config -g platform.php "$target_php.0"
COMPOSER_HOME="$composer_home_dir" composer --working-dir="$lock_tmp_dir" update --no-install --no-audit --no-interaction --no-progress
cp "$lock_tmp_dir/composer.lock" "composer.lock.php-$target_php"
```

## Actions Best Practices

Apply these rules to every workflow created by this skill:

- Pin every external action with the full 40-character commit SHA.
- Keep workflow YAML free of explanatory comments, including release-tag comments
  after action SHAs. Use clear job and step names.
- Verify each SHA from the action's original repository:
  ```bash
  gh release view --repo actions/checkout --json tagName,publishedAt,url
  git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/checkout.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'
  ```
- Use top-level `permissions: contents: read` and only grant additional
  permissions for a step that truly needs them.
- Use `pull_request`, not `pull_request_target`, for untrusted PR code.
- Use `concurrency` with PR number or ref and `cancel-in-progress: true`.
- Set `fail-fast: false` for version matrices so all supported minors report.
- Add `timeout-minutes` to jobs.
- Give every job and every step a clear `name`.
- Do not use `continue-on-error` for required lint or test gates.
- When versioned lock files are used, copy the matching lock to `composer.lock`
  before validation and installation, then install with locked dependencies and
  `require-lock-file: true`. Run `composer check-platform-reqs` after installation.
- When no lock file is committed, do not claim `dependency-versions: locked` and
  do not set `require-lock-file: true`; deliberately install the dependency mode
  the project chose.
- Let `ramsey/composer-install` handle Composer caching; do not add a second
  Composer cache step unless the project has a measured reason.

Job timeouts, PHP memory limits, and worker counts are operational starting
points. Measure sustained runtime, peak memory, and runner capacity, then adjust
them with headroom. Never use those settings to narrow a gate, skip targets, or
turn a quality failure into a pass. The template's values are not target-project
facts.

## Updating Action Pins

When refreshing the template, resolve current releases and SHAs before editing:

```bash
gh release view --repo actions/checkout --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/checkout.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'

gh release view --repo shivammathur/setup-php --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/shivammathur/setup-php.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'

gh release view --repo ramsey/composer-install --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/ramsey/composer-install.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'
```

Use the SHA returned for the exact tag. Do not use a moving branch, a major tag,
or an abbreviated SHA. Do not append the tag as a YAML comment.

## Verification

After editing the workflow:

```bash
git diff --check
go run github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@latest .github/workflows/ci.yml
```

Run local Composer checks that are reasonably available:

```bash
composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
# Repeat validation with each target-project lock when versioned locks exist.
composer format:check
composer phpstan
composer compat
composer loc-guard
composer tree-guard
composer deptrac
composer test:unit
composer test
```

Then check that nothing configured was left out of the workflow. Every Composer
script the project treats as a gate should appear in `ci.yml`:

```bash
composer run-script --list
grep -o 'composer [a-z:-]*' .github/workflows/ci.yml | sort -u
```

If a local check cannot run because of the local PHP version or missing tools,
state that clearly and rely on the CI job that covers it.

- [Composer Install action](https://github.com/ramsey/composer-install)

          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
      - run: composer test

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
      - run: composer lint

  bench:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
      - run: composer bench

  mutation:
    name: Mutation Testing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: dom, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: pcov
          # A mutant that turns a loop into an endless loop keeps allocating and emitting
          # PHP warnings; bounding memory ends it as a fatal error within seconds instead
          # of holding a thread until the Infection timeout.
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G
      - name: Install package dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Install isolated Infection dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker/tools/infection
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          # ParaTest is not used by this job; validate the package runtime and isolated tool.
          composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
          composer --working-dir=tools/infection check-platform-reqs
      - name: Mutation testing on changed lines
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G tools/infection/vendor/bin/infection
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --git-diff-lines
          --git-diff-base="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"
          --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations
          --min-msi=85
          --min-covered-msi=85
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G tools/infection/vendor/bin/infection
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=4G -r '
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '
      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: sql-faker-infection
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

          value: 'src/Grammar/Resource/'
    # Reads upstream Bison and Lemon sources into grammar models.
    - name: Compiler
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Compiler/'
    # Failures raised while generating SQL.
    - name: GenerationException
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Exception/'
    # Immutable requested productions, lexical values and budgets.
    - name: GenerationPlan
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Plan/'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\Generation\\Plan\\TRequiresNonEmpty$'
    # Terminal occurrences, their derivation provenance and structural rewriting.
    - name: Token
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Token/'
    # Database-independent value domains and choices.
    - name: Value
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Value/'
    # Lexemes, candidates, resolved output, boundaries and the dialect lexical contract.
    - name: Lexeme
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Lexeme/'
    # Generators that offer lexeme candidates for a terminal.
    - name: Candidate
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Candidate/'
    # Resolves candidates against boundaries and serializes the chosen output.
    - name: Output
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Output/'
    # Walks productions under a plan and computes bounded completion.
    - name: Derivation
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Derivation/'
    # Compiles decision bytes into plans.
    - name: Choice
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/Choice/'
    # Records what generation reached and emitted.
    - name: Coverage
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Coverage/'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\Coverage\\(Measurement|Trace|Checkpoint|Snapshot|History|Entry|Rewrite)$'
    # Coordinates derivation, rewriting and lexical realization.
    - name: Generation
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/[^/]+\.php$'
    # Public Faker entry points and composition of the selected database.
    - name: Provider
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/[^/]+Provider\.php$'
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Provider/'
    - name: MySqlGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Grammar/'
    - name: MySqlTokenization
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Tokenization/'
    - name: MySqlValue
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Generation/Value/'
    - name: MySqlSpacing
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Generation/Spacing/'
    - name: MySqlLexeme
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Generation/Lexeme/'
    - name: MySqlRewrite
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Generation/Rewrite/'
    # Runtime composition and plan presets; StatementType is a class_alias declared there.
    - name: MySql
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/[^/]+\.php$'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\MySql\\StatementType$'
    - name: PostgreSqlGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Grammar/'
    - name: PostgreSqlLookahead
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Lookahead/'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\PostgreSql\\Lookahead\\LookaheadRule$'
    - name: PostgreSqlTokenization
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Tokenization/'
    - name: PostgreSqlValue
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Generation/Value/'
    - name: PostgreSqlLexeme
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Generation/Lexeme/'
    - name: PostgreSqlRewrite
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Generation/Rewrite/'
    - name: PostgreSql
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/[^/]+\.php$'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\PostgreSql\\StatementType$'
    - name: SqliteGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Grammar/'
    - name: SqliteTokenization
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Tokenization/'
    - name: SqliteValue
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Generation/Value/'
    - name: SqliteLexeme
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Generation/Lexeme/'
    - name: SqliteRewrite
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Generation/Rewrite/'
    - name: Sqlite
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/[^/]+\.php$'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\Sqlite\\StatementType$'
    - name: Faker
      collectors:
        - type: classLike
          value: ^Faker\\.*
    - name: PhpRuntime
      collectors:
        - type: php_internal
          value: '.*'
  ruleset:
    GrammarModel: [PhpRuntime]

name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/sql-faker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/docs-preview.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: sql-faker-docs-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          # The locked ParaTest version supports PHP 8.1 through 8.3.
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker check-platform-reqs

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/docgen-cache
          key: sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/sql-faker/composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/sql-faker/composer.lock') }}-
            sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the coverage report the site reads
        run: composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker test -- --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml

      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker docgen -- --coverage=packages/sql-faker/build/coverage-xml \
            --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../packages/sql-faker/build/docs/ ./

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Build GitHub Pages and wait for publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          expected_sha="$(git -C .docs-branch rev-parse HEAD)"
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds" > /dev/null
          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            build="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds/latest")"
            if [ "$(jq -r .commit <<< "$build")" = "$expected_sha" ]; then
              case "$(jq -r .status <<< "$build")" in
                built) exit 0 ;;
                errored) jq .error <<< "$build"; exit 1 ;;
              esac
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo 'Timed out waiting for GitHub Pages publication.' >&2
          exit 1
name: Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/sql-faker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/docs-preview.yml'
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - closed

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: sql-faker-docs-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  preview:
    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action != 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          # The locked ParaTest version supports PHP 8.1 through 8.3.
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker check-platform-reqs

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/docgen-cache
          key: sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/sql-faker/composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/sql-faker/composer.lock') }}-
            sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the coverage report the preview reads
        run: composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker test -- --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml

      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker docgen -- --coverage=packages/sql-faker/build/coverage-xml --diff="${BASE_SHA}" \
            --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the preview
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
          rsync -a --checksum --delete ../packages/sql-faker/build/docs/ "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
          touch .nojekyll

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: preview pull request #${PR_NUMBER} at ${HEAD_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Build GitHub Pages and wait for publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          expected_sha="$(git -C .docs-branch rev-parse HEAD)"
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds" > /dev/null
          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            build="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds/latest")"
            if [ "$(jq -r .commit <<< "$build")" = "$expected_sha" ]; then
              case "$(jq -r .status <<< "$build")" in
                built) exit 0 ;;
                errored) jq .error <<< "$build"; exit 1 ;;
              esac
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo 'Timed out waiting for GitHub Pages publication.' >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          preview_url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"

          comment_file="$(mktemp)"
          cat > "$comment_file" <<EOF
          <!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->
          **Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}

          Generated in diff mode against ${BASE_REF}. Use **Off**, **Diff**, or
          **Changes** at the top of the page to select the documentation view.

          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA}. The preview is removed when this pull request is closed.
          EOF
          comment_id="$(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --jq '.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | startswith("<!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->"))) | .id' | tail -n 1)"
          if [ -n "$comment_id" ]; then
            gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" -F "body=@${comment_file}"
          else
            gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --body-file "$comment_file"
          fi

  cleanup:
    name: Remove the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}

      - name: Remove the preview
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rm -rf "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch carries no preview of this pull request."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: remove the preview of pull request #${PR_NUMBER}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Build GitHub Pages and wait for publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          expected_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds" > /dev/null
          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            build="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds/latest")"
            if [ "$(jq -r .commit <<< "$build")" = "$expected_sha" ]; then
              case "$(jq -r .status <<< "$build")" in
                built) exit 0 ;;
                errored) jq .error <<< "$build"; exit 1 ;;
              esac
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo 'Timed out waiting for GitHub Pages publication.' >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          comment_id="$(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --jq '.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | startswith("<!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->"))) | .id' | tail -n 1)"
          if [ -n "$comment_id" ]; then
            comment_file="$(mktemp)"
            cat > "$comment_file" <<'EOF'
          <!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->
          The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.
          EOF
            gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" -F "body=@${comment_file}"
          fi
name: Fuzz (sql-faker)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_runs:
        description: Maximum mutation iterations after the initial corpus is replayed
        required: true
        default: '10000'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  MYSQL_VERSION: '8.4.7'

jobs:
  syntax:
    name: Syntax / ${{ matrix.target.database }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target:
          - { database: mysql, script: fuzz_mysql_syntax.php, extensions: 'mbstring, pcntl, pdo_mysql' }
          - { database: pg, script: fuzz_pg_syntax.php, extensions: 'mbstring, pcntl, pdo_pgsql, pgsql' }
          - { database: sqlite, script: fuzz_sqlite_syntax.php, extensions: 'mbstring, pcntl, pdo_sqlite' }
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/sql-faker
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ${{ matrix.target.extensions }}
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check runtime platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
      - name: Validate the manual run budget
        env:
          FUZZ_MAX_RUNS: ${{ inputs.max_runs || '10000' }}
        run: |
          case "$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*) echo 'max_runs must be a positive integer.' >&2; exit 2 ;;
          esac
          if [ "${#FUZZ_MAX_RUNS}" -gt 8 ] || [ "$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS" -lt 1 ]; then
            echo 'max_runs must be between 1 and 99999999.' >&2
            exit 2
          fi
      - name: Restore the evolving raw-input corpus
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}
          key: sql-faker-corpus-v3-${{ matrix.target.database }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: sql-faker-corpus-v3-${{ matrix.target.database }}-
      - name: Restore grammar coverage snapshots independently of the corpus
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/fuzz/coverage/${{ matrix.target.database }}
          key: sql-faker-coverage-v1-${{ matrix.target.database }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: sql-faker-coverage-v1-${{ matrix.target.database }}-
      - name: Run PHP-Fuzzer
        env:
          FUZZ_MAX_RUNS: ${{ inputs.max_runs || '10000' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/fuzz "fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}"
          vendor/bin/php-fuzzer fuzz \
            "fuzz/${{ matrix.target.script }}" \
            "fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}/" \
            "--max-runs=$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS" 2>&1 | tee "build/fuzz/${{ matrix.target.database }}.log"
      - name: Open an issue for a finding
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          FUZZ_DATABASE: ${{ matrix.target.database }}
          FUZZ_SCRIPT: ${{ matrix.target.script }}
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');
            const crypto = require('node:crypto');
            const database = process.env.FUZZ_DATABASE;
            const script = process.env.FUZZ_SCRIPT;
            const root = path.resolve('packages/sql-faker');
            const log = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, `build/fuzz/${database}.log`), 'utf8');
            const finding = log.match(/^(?:CORPUS )?CRASH in (.+)!$/m);
            if (!finding) return;
            const input = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(root, finding[1]));
            const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(input).digest('hex');
            const marker = `<!-- sql-faker-fuzz:${database}:${hash} -->`;
            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
              ...context.repo, state: 'open', per_page: 100
            });
            if (issues.some(issue => !issue.pull_request && issue.body?.includes(marker))) return;
            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const body = [
              marker,
              `PHP-Fuzzer found a generation or database validation failure for ${database}.`,
              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              `Workflow and input artifact: ${run} (sql-faker-fuzz-${database})`,
              'Run from packages/sql-faker after extracting the artifact:',
              '```sh',
              `vendor/bin/php-fuzzer run-single fuzz/${script} '${finding[1]}'`,
              '```',
              `Input SHA-256: ${hash}`,
              '<details><summary>PHP-Fuzzer output</summary>',
              '', '```text', log.slice(-45000), '```', '</details>'
            ].join('\n\n');
            await github.rest.issues.create({
              ...context.repo,
              title: `[sql-faker fuzz] ${database}: ${hash.slice(0, 12)}`,
              body
            });
      - name: Save the evolving corpus
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}
          key: sql-faker-corpus-v3-${{ matrix.target.database }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      - name: Save grammar coverage history
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/fuzz/coverage/${{ matrix.target.database }}
          key: sql-faker-coverage-v1-${{ matrix.target.database }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      - name: Upload PHP-Fuzzer inputs, output and grammar coverage
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: sql-faker-fuzz-${{ matrix.target.database }}
          path: |
            packages/sql-faker/crash-*
            packages/sql-faker/build/fuzz/${{ matrix.target.database }}.log
            packages/sql-faker/fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}/
            packages/sql-faker/fuzz/coverage/${{ matrix.target.database }}/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/sql-faker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/docs-preview.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: sql-faker-docs-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          # The locked ParaTest version supports PHP 8.1 through 8.3.
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker check-platform-reqs

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/docgen-cache
          key: sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/sql-faker/composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/sql-faker/composer.lock') }}-
            sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the coverage report the site reads
        run: composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker test -- --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml

      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker docgen -- --coverage=packages/sql-faker/build/coverage-xml \
            --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../packages/sql-faker/build/docs/ ./

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Build GitHub Pages and wait for publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          expected_sha="$(git -C .docs-branch rev-parse HEAD)"
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds" > /dev/null
          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            build="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds/latest")"
            if [ "$(jq -r .commit <<< "$build")" = "$expected_sha" ]; then
              case "$(jq -r .status <<< "$build")" in
                built) exit 0 ;;
                errored) jq .error <<< "$build"; exit 1 ;;
              esac
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo 'Timed out waiting for GitHub Pages publication.' >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the preview
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
          rsync -a --checksum --delete ../packages/sql-faker/build/docs/ "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
          touch .nojekyll

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: preview pull request #${PR_NUMBER} at ${HEAD_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Build GitHub Pages and wait for publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          expected_sha="$(git -C .docs-branch rev-parse HEAD)"
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds" > /dev/null
          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            build="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds/latest")"
            if [ "$(jq -r .commit <<< "$build")" = "$expected_sha" ]; then
              case "$(jq -r .status <<< "$build")" in
                built) exit 0 ;;
                errored) jq .error <<< "$build"; exit 1 ;;
              esac
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo 'Timed out waiting for GitHub Pages publication.' >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          preview_url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"

          comment_file="$(mktemp)"
          cat > "$comment_file" <<EOF
          <!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->
          **Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}

          Generated in diff mode against ${BASE_REF}. Use **Off**, **Diff**, or
          **Changes** at the top of the page to select the documentation view.

          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA}. The preview is removed when this pull request is closed.
          EOF
          comment_id="$(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --jq '.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | startswith("<!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->"))) | .id' | tail -n 1)"
          if [ -n "$comment_id" ]; then
            gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" -F "body=@${comment_file}"
          else
            gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --body-file "$comment_file"
          fi

  cleanup:
    name: Remove the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}

      - name: Remove the preview
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: remove the preview of pull request #${PR_NUMBER}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Build GitHub Pages and wait for publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          expected_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds" > /dev/null
          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            build="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds/latest")"
            if [ "$(jq -r .commit <<< "$build")" = "$expected_sha" ]; then
              case "$(jq -r .status <<< "$build")" in
                built) exit 0 ;;
                errored) jq .error <<< "$build"; exit 1 ;;
              esac
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo 'Timed out waiting for GitHub Pages publication.' >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          comment_id="$(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --jq '.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | startswith("<!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->"))) | .id' | tail -n 1)"
          if [ -n "$comment_id" ]; then
            comment_file="$(mktemp)"
            cat > "$comment_file" <<'EOF'
          <!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->
          The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.
          EOF
            gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" -F "body=@${comment_file}"
          fi
name: Fuzz (sql-faker)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_runs:
        description: Maximum mutation iterations after the initial corpus is replayed
        required: true
        default: '10000'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  MYSQL_VERSION: '8.4.7'

jobs:
  syntax:
    name: Syntax / ${{ matrix.target.database }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target:
          - { database: mysql, script: fuzz_mysql_syntax.php, extensions: 'mbstring, pcntl, pdo_mysql' }
          - { database: pg, script: fuzz_pg_syntax.php, extensions: 'mbstring, pcntl, pdo_pgsql, pgsql' }
          - { database: sqlite, script: fuzz_sqlite_syntax.php, extensions: 'mbstring, pcntl, pdo_sqlite' }
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/sql-faker
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ${{ matrix.target.extensions }}
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check runtime platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
      - name: Validate the manual run budget
        env:
          FUZZ_MAX_RUNS: ${{ inputs.max_runs || '10000' }}
        run: |
          case "$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*) echo 'max_runs must be a positive integer.' >&2; exit 2 ;;
          esac
          if [ "${#FUZZ_MAX_RUNS}" -gt 8 ] || [ "$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS" -lt 1 ]; then
            echo 'max_runs must be between 1 and 99999999.' >&2
            exit 2
          fi
      - name: Restore the evolving raw-input corpus
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}
          key: sql-faker-corpus-v3-${{ matrix.target.database }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: sql-faker-corpus-v3-${{ matrix.target.database }}-
      - name: Restore grammar coverage snapshots independently of the corpus
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/fuzz/coverage/${{ matrix.target.database }}
          key: sql-faker-coverage-v1-${{ matrix.target.database }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: sql-faker-coverage-v1-${{ matrix.target.database }}-
      - name: Run PHP-Fuzzer
        env:
          FUZZ_MAX_RUNS: ${{ inputs.max_runs || '10000' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/fuzz "fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}"
          vendor/bin/php-fuzzer fuzz \
            "fuzz/${{ matrix.target.script }}" \
            "fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}/" \
            "--max-runs=$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS" 2>&1 | tee "build/fuzz/${{ matrix.target.database }}.log"
      - name: Open an issue for a finding
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          FUZZ_DATABASE: ${{ matrix.target.database }}
          FUZZ_SCRIPT: ${{ matrix.target.script }}
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');
            const crypto = require('node:crypto');
            const database = process.env.FUZZ_DATABASE;
            const script = process.env.FUZZ_SCRIPT;
            const root = path.resolve('packages/sql-faker');
            const log = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, `build/fuzz/${database}.log`), 'utf8');
            const finding = log.match(/^(?:CORPUS )?CRASH in (.+)!$/m);
            if (!finding) return;
            const input = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(root, finding[1]));
            const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(input).digest('hex');
            const marker = `<!-- sql-faker-fuzz:${database}:${hash} -->`;
            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
              ...context.repo, state: 'open', per_page: 100
            });
            if (issues.some(issue => !issue.pull_request && issue.body?.includes(marker))) return;
            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const body = [
              marker,
              `PHP-Fuzzer found a generation or database validation failure for ${database}.`,
              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              `Workflow and input artifact: ${run} (sql-faker-fuzz-${database})`,
              'Run from packages/sql-faker after extracting the artifact:',
              '```sh',
              `vendor/bin/php-fuzzer run-single fuzz/${script} '${finding[1]}'`,
              '```',
              `Input SHA-256: ${hash}`,
              '<details><summary>PHP-Fuzzer output</summary>',
              '', '```text', log.slice(-45000), '```', '</details>'
            ].join('\n\n');
            await github.rest.issues.create({
              ...context.repo,
              title: `[sql-faker fuzz] ${database}: ${hash.slice(0, 12)}`,
              body
            });
      - name: Save the evolving corpus
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}
          key: sql-faker-corpus-v3-${{ matrix.target.database }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      - name: Save grammar coverage history
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/fuzz/coverage/${{ matrix.target.database }}
          key: sql-faker-coverage-v1-${{ matrix.target.database }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      - name: Upload PHP-Fuzzer inputs, output and grammar coverage
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: sql-faker-fuzz-${{ matrix.target.database }}
          path: |
            packages/sql-faker/crash-*
            packages/sql-faker/build/fuzz/${{ matrix.target.database }}.log
            packages/sql-faker/fuzz/corpus/${{ matrix.target.database }}/
            packages/sql-faker/fuzz/coverage/${{ matrix.target.database }}/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

### Reference an action by commit SHA in YAML

Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/choose-what-workflows-do/find-and-customize-actions

Pin an action using an immutable full commit SHA from the action's repository for maximum reliability. Action updates and bug fixes will not be automatically pulled.

```yaml
steps:
  - uses: actions/javascript-action@a824008085750b8e136effc585c3cd6082bd575f
```

--------------------------------

### Define granular GITHUB_TOKEN permissions

Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax

Specifies individual read, write, or none access for GITHUB_TOKEN scopes. Any omitted permission scopes will automatically default to none.

```yaml
permissions:
  actions: read|write|none
  artifact-metadata: read|write|none
  attestations: read|write|none
  checks: read|write|none
  code-quality: read|write|none
  contents: read|write|none
  deployments: read|write|none
  id-token: write|none
  issues: read|write|none
  discussions: read|write|none
  packages: read|write|none
  pages: read|write|none
  pull-requests: read|write|none

  security-events: read|write|none
  statuses: read|write|none
  vulnerability-alerts: read|none
```

--------------------------------

### Set workflow-level OIDC permissions

Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/security/oidc

Example of setting id-token and contents permissions at the workflow level.

```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write # This is required for requesting the JWT
  contents: read # This is required for actions/checkout
```

--------------------------------

### Insecure pull_request_target Workflow Configuration

Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/security/securely-using-pull_request_target

This example demonstrates an insecure pattern where a fork's code is checked out using its SHA and then executed via a build command.

```yaml
# INSECURE. Provided as an example only.
on:
  pull_request_target:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Test
        run: make test
```

### Using third-party actions > Pin actions to a full-length commit SHA

Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/security/secure-use

Pinning an action to a full-length commit SHA is the most secure method, as it ensures the action remains immutable and protects against backdoors. Organizations and repositories can enforce policies to require full-length commit SHAs for all actions.
