name: CI (sql-faker)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/sql-faker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/sql-faker.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/sql-faker-fuzz.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/sql-faker

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
        if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
      - name: Run the tests in parallel
        run: composer test

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check the formatting
        run: composer format:check
      - name: Analyse with PHPStan
        run: composer phpstan
      - name: Check PHP compatibility
        run: composer compat
      - name: Check the source metrics
        run: composer loc-guard
      - name: Check the directory structure
        run: composer tree-guard
      - name: Check the architecture layers
        run: composer deptrac

  bench:
    name: Benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Run the benchmarks
        run: composer bench

  mutation:
    name: Mutation Testing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ctype, date, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: pcov
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G
      - name: Validate the Composer manifests and lock files
        run: |
          composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
          composer --working-dir=tools/infection validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install package dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Install isolated Infection dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker/tools/infection
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
          composer --working-dir=tools/infection check-platform-reqs
      - name: Mutation testing on changed lines
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G tools/infection/vendor/bin/infection
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --git-diff-lines
          --git-diff-base="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"
          --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations
          --min-msi=85
          --min-covered-msi=85
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G tools/infection/vendor/bin/infection
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=4G -r '
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '
      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: sql-faker-infection
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/sql-faker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/docs-preview.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: sql-faker-docs-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          # The locked ParaTest version supports PHP 8.1 through 8.3.
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer --working-dir=packages/sql-faker check-platform-reqs

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/docgen-cache
          key: sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/sql-faker/composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/sql-faker/composer.lock') }}-
            sql-faker-docgen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the coverage report the site reads

          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds" > /dev/null
          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            build="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds/latest")"
            if [ "$(jq -r .commit <<< "$build")" = "$expected_sha" ]; then
              case "$(jq -r .status <<< "$build")" in
                built) exit 0 ;;
                errored) jq .error <<< "$build"; exit 1 ;;
              esac
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo 'Timed out waiting for GitHub Pages publication.' >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          comment_id="$(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --jq '.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | startswith("<!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->"))) | .id' | tail -n 1)"
          if [ -n "$comment_id" ]; then
            comment_file="$(mktemp)"
            cat > "$comment_file" <<'EOF'
          <!-- sql-faker-docgen-preview -->
          The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.
          EOF
            gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" -F "body=@${comment_file}"
          fi
"}}

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /tmp/sql-faker-toolkit-actions-pr.md <<'EOF'
The SQLFaker workflow already runs all configured toolkit gates, but combines six lint checks into one step and leaves several Actions, installation settings, permissions, and timeouts implicit. Apply `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit`'s `setup-toolkit-github-actions` skill to make those checks individually visible and the workflow reproducible.

- Give every job and step a name; run formatting, PHPStan, PHPCompatibility, LocGuard, TreeGuard, and Deptrac as separate lint steps.
- Pin all external Actions to verified release commit SHAs, limit the token to `contents: read`, add job timeouts, and key concurrency by event and PR number/ref.
- Validate Composer manifests/locks, explicitly require locked installation, and declare extensions from the package and isolated Infection dependency graphs plus PHPUnit's time-limit configuration.
- Keep the PHP 8.1–8.5 parallel test matrix. Run lint and the existing benchmark on PHP 8.3, the highest runtime supported by the entire committed development graph. Preserve the existing mutation commands, thresholds, memory limit, and report artifacts.

The existing lock pins ParaTest 7.3.2, whose declared PHP range ends at 8.3. Full development platform checks therefore run on PHP 8.1–8.3; PHP 8.4/8.5 validate library requirements and retain the existing parallel tests outside ParaTest's declared support range. The latter is an existing tooling limitation, not a claim of full development-dependency compatibility. Resolving it requires a separate PHPUnit/dependency-policy change; this PR is limited to the requested Actions final adjustments.

Documentation publishing/previews and scheduled fuzzing already have separate workflows. The benchmark comparison workflow is being handled in #309; this PR only adjusts the setup of the existing benchmark job.

Validation:

- `git diff --check` and actionlint 1.7.12 passed.
- Strict Composer validation passed for both the package and isolated Infection manifests/locks.
- All six `composer lint` gates passed locally on PHP 8.5.8 (Deptrac's bundled dependency emits deprecations on that runtime).
- Reproduced the ParaTest platform constraint failure with `composer check-platform-reqs` on PHP 8.5.8. Local PHP 8.3 cannot start because its ICU shared library is missing; GitHub CI verifies the PHP 8.3 jobs.

# AGENTS

This file is for agents to understand the context of the project.

## Project Goal

Implement a Zero Table Dependencies (ZTD) mechanism for PHP 8.1+ using a PDO Proxy.
The goal is to enable testing without modifying the physical database by using CTEs to shadow tables and simulate writes.

## Core Concepts

- **CTE Shadowing**: Using `WITH` clauses to mock table data for SELECT queries.
- **Result Select Query**: Converting INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE queries into SELECT queries that return the data that would have been modified.

## Tech Stack

- PHP 8.1+
- MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite
- PHPStan (Level Max)
- PHP-CS-Fixer
- PHPUnit
- Infection
- PHP-Fuzzer

## Coding Rule

- Follow the fix instructions provided in lint error messages

## Packages

### packages/ztd-query-core

Core library for ZTD Query. Provides the foundational interfaces, session management, and query routing logic.
Contains `Session`, query classification interfaces, rewriter contracts, and schema abstractions.
No platform-specific or adapter code — those live in separate packages.

### packages/ztd-query-mysql

MySQL platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution using phpmyadmin/sql-parser.
Provides `MySqlSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with MySQL support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-postgres

PostgreSQL platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution.
Provides `PgSqlSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with PostgreSQL support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-sqlite

SQLite platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution.
Provides `SqliteSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with SQLite support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter

PDO adapter for ZTD Query. Provides `ZtdPdo` (extends PDO) and `ZtdPdoStatement` (extends PDOStatement) that transparently apply ZTD rewriting via delegation pattern.
Depends on ztd-query-php core and ztd-query-mysql. Integration tests use MySQL Testcontainers.

### packages/ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

MySQLi adapter for ZTD Query. Provides `ZtdMysqli` (extends mysqli) and `ZtdMysqliStatement` (extends mysqli_stmt) that transparently apply ZTD rewriting via delegation pattern.
Depends on ztd-query-php core and ztd-query-mysql. Integration tests use MySQL Testcontainers.

### packages/sql-faker

Faker Provider for generating syntactically valid SQL statements for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.
Based on official grammar definitions, can generate any statement type (DML, DDL, TCL, etc.) and SQL fragments (expressions, clauses, subqueries, CTEs).
Supports MySQL 5.6–9.1, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Used for fuzz testing.

### packages/sql-fixture

Faker Provider for generating test fixture data from SQL schemas.
Parses CREATE TABLE statements and generates type-appropriate fake data using PHP-Faker.
Provides three usage modes: SQL string-based (`FixtureProvider`), PDO connection-based (`DatabaseFixtureProvider`), and DDL file directory-based (`FileFixtureProvider`).
Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Includes object hydration via `ReflectionHydrator`. Used for fuzz testing and integration tests.

### packages/phpstan-custom-rules

Project-specific PHPStan rules package shared across ztd-query packages.
Provides custom rules for code quality and consistency, including forbidden comments (`@phpstan-ignore*`, `//`), restrictions in test classes (no properties/constants/private methods), and source/unit test pairing checks.
Loaded from each package `phpstan.neon` via `vendor/k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules/extension.neon`.

## Documents

- [docs/ztd-mechanism.md](docs/ztd-mechanism.md) - Overview and design of the ZTD mechanism
- [docs/mysql-spec.md](docs/mysql-spec.md) - How ZTD handles MySQL SQL statements
- [docs/postgres-spec.md](docs/postgres-spec.md) - How ZTD handles PostgreSQL SQL statements
- [docs/sqlite-spec.md](docs/sqlite-spec.md) - How ZTD handles SQLite SQL statements
- [docs/sql-support-matrix.md](docs/sql-support-matrix.md) - Supported SQL statements and their status

The SQLFaker workflow already runs all configured toolkit gates, but combines six lint checks into one step and leaves several Actions, installation settings, permissions, and timeouts implicit. Apply `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit`'s `setup-toolkit-github-actions` skill to make those checks individually visible and the workflow reproducible.

- Give every job and step a name; run formatting, PHPStan, PHPCompatibility, LocGuard, TreeGuard, and Deptrac as separate lint steps.
- Pin all external Actions to verified release commit SHAs, limit the token to `contents: read`, add job timeouts, and key concurrency by event and PR number/ref.
- Validate Composer manifests/locks, explicitly require locked installation, and declare extensions from the package and isolated Infection dependency graphs plus PHPUnit's time-limit configuration.
- Keep the PHP 8.1–8.5 parallel test matrix. Run lint and the existing benchmark on PHP 8.3, the highest runtime supported by the entire committed development graph. Preserve the existing mutation commands, thresholds, memory limit, and report artifacts.

The existing lock pins ParaTest 7.3.2, whose declared PHP range ends at 8.3. Full development platform checks therefore run on PHP 8.1–8.3; PHP 8.4/8.5 validate library requirements and retain the existing parallel tests outside ParaTest's declared support range. The latter is an existing tooling limitation, not a claim of full development-dependency compatibility. Resolving it requires a separate PHPUnit/dependency-policy change; this PR is limited to the requested Actions final adjustments.

Documentation publishing/previews and scheduled fuzzing already have separate workflows. The benchmark comparison workflow is being handled in #309; this PR only adjusts the setup of the existing benchmark job.

Validation:

- `git diff --check` and actionlint 1.7.12 passed.
- Strict Composer validation passed for both the package and isolated Infection manifests/locks.
- All six `composer lint` gates passed locally on PHP 8.5.8 (Deptrac's bundled dependency emits deprecations on that runtime).
- Reproduced the ParaTest platform constraint failure with `composer check-platform-reqs` on PHP 8.5.8. Local PHP 8.3 cannot start because its ICU shared library is missing; GitHub CI verifies the PHP 8.3 jobs.
- Local `composer test:unit` passed on PHP 8.5.8. The additional local parallel run reported a 1-second timeout in `MySqlGrammarTest::testLoadWithExplicitVersionPreservesCompiledStructure`; a filtered rerun reproduced that timeout, and the full local parallel process later exceeded Composer's 300-second process timeout. These local runs did not pass; the existing PHPUnit and Composer limits are unchanged.
- [CI run 34689227106](https://github.com/k-kinzal/ztd-query-php/actions/runs/34689227106) passed on commit `426129a969d688c18370cef3206d9a5095fc6d5e`: all five PHP test jobs, all six lint steps, the benchmark, and changed-line mutation testing. The PHP 8.3 test job reports 5,645 tests and 15,849 assertions. Merge Gatekeeper also passed.

The SQLFaker workflow already runs all configured toolkit gates, but combines six lint checks into one step and leaves several Actions, installation settings, permissions, and timeouts implicit. The existing lock pins ParaTest 7.3.2, whose declared PHP range ends at 8.3. Full development platform checks therefore run on PHP 8.1–8.3; PHP 8.4/8.5 validate library requirements and retain the existing parallel tests outside ParaTest's declared support range. The latter is an existing tooling limitation, not a claim of full development-dependency compatibility. Resolving it requires a separate PHPUnit/dependency-policy change; this PR is limited to Actions adjustments.

- `git diff --check`, actionlint 1.7.12, and strict package Composer validation passed after merging main.
- Verified that every configured lint gate remains a named step, every external Action uses a full SHA, both mutation commands use the Infection PHAR, and no workflow references the removed `tools/infection` directory.
- GitHub Actions is checking the updated commit `90366aaaca6a4992cc6aa87973a405a8b70edca1`.

Full test and lint verification uses GitHub Actions: local PHP 8.3 cannot start because its ICU shared library is missing, and additional local PHP 8.5 test runs on the original PR head encountered a 1-second PHPUnit timeout and Composer's 300-second parallel-process timeout. Those test limits have not been relaxed.
EOF
